response.rationale: These are two different concepts. A is the Hive, the colony unit. TreatmentRepository looks up treatments by it through `findByHive(hiveId: string)`. B is the Hive Scale, a weighing device modeled as ScaleRecord. ScaleService handles it with its own ScaleRepository methods (findBySerial, findByHive, save) and with weight readings. ScaleService also calls HiveRepository.findById and ScaleRepository.findByHive, so a scale points to a hive. That makes it a separate thing linked to a hive, not another name for one. Their names overlap, but they don't model the same real-world thing.
